cases.name: Rachael Ann Pauls
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Rachael enjoyed working at Able House in Richland Center taking care of the residents. She enjoyed fishing in Northern Wisconsin with her father. Rachael loved her dogs Bear and Lyric. She enjoyed spending time with her family, especially her nieces and nephews. "
cases.narrative: He allegedly beat her to death causing extensive trauma her face, torso and internal bleeding. The responding EMT found that she was cold and had no pulse. The EMT observed bruising on her face and belly, as well as a laceration of four to six inches long on her right side. Forensic Pathologist Dr. Vincent Tanchida made a preliminary finding that Pauls died of a homicide (struck by other). The cause of death was blunt force trauma of torso with laceration of the mesentery and internal hemorrhage. Although not the cause of death, Dr. Tranchida noted that there were two hemorrhagic fractures of the lateral aspects of right ribs 7 and 8.
